art_direction.view: three-quarter side view, full body, facing right

pipeline.normalization: tools/normalize_sprite.py: premultiplied LANCZOS fit, binary alpha, palette from opaque pixels with 1/4 slots reserved for saturated accents, nearest-colour mapping without dithering, small-cluster removal, 1 px ink outline (#101820), bottom-centre placement. --cleanup for sprites without a high-resolution source (binary alpha + outline, no resize).
pipeline.alpha_cleanup: low-alpha black background film (alpha < 16, RGB <= 8) set to 0; near-opaque pixels (alpha >= 240) set to 255; glow alpha preserved
pipeline.transparency_source: Magpie native transparent background output; alpha verified with Pillow
pipeline.animation: Version 0.10.0 adds generated frame sets for the player: 4-frame run cycle (12 fps), 3-frame jump/fall, 3-frame melee attack, 2-frame cast, 2-frame hurt/stagger and 2-frame dodge (16 frames in total). Each strip is generated on transparent background with the idle sprite as reference, sliced on alpha gaps by tools/slice_anim_sheet.py, fitted to one shared height across the set, quantized with one shared palette, outlined and bottom-centre anchored. ActorMotion still owns squash, lean, bob and the feet pin.
pipeline.runtime_review: 2026-11-02 0.9.0: pixel_smooth shader (crisp sampling + cyan rim light), PixelSprite grounding, whole-number scales, whole-sprite ActorMotion pinned at the feet. Screenshots checked at 1280x720.
pipeline.pixel_qa: python tests/check_pixel_assets.py --demo — exact canvas size, binary alpha, transparent corners, <=32 colours, foot baseline on the canvas bottom row, uncompressed/no-mipmap import. Exit 1 on any failure.

backgrounds.source: assets/concept/demo/bg_ink_archive_*_raw.png (Magpie codex/gpt-image-2, 2026-11-03), quantised to the shared 32-colour budget

portraits.source: cut from the existing 800x1000 pixel portraits so the faces stay identical; no generated replacement face is used

tiles.spec: 64x16, four 16x16 tiles (ground top/fill, platform top/fill), <=32 colours

not_in_demo: assets/backgrounds/ink_archive.png and the other paintings — chapters 2-4 only
assets/portraits/*.png 800x1000 — Wenjin/Baiyu only; the Chapter 1 demo uses the 192x256 pixel cards

source.prompt: ROLE/PURPOSE: production sprite sheet for a 2D side-view action game enemy. SUBJECT: the exact creature in the reference image; 4 rows x 6 columns, same creature, same size and facing in every cell. Row 1 IDLE, Row 2 MOVE, Row 3 ATTACK (2 wind-up, strike, impact, 2 recover), Row 4 DEATH (recoil, stagger, collapse, break apart, dissolve into ink).
source.license: 项目自用生成素材

known_gaps: Downscaled generated pixel art retains some anti-aliased edge pixels and fine-detail noise; Pixelorama/Aseprite cleanup is recommended before pixel-perfect final animation.
Backgrounds are single flattened images; separate parallax layers are not included.
NPC portraits are derived from internal likeness references; confirm likeness usage rights before public release.
Player run/attack/cast frame sets are key-frame approximations, not hand-tuned Aseprite cycles; a future pass can add in-between frames and per-frame smear.
